title: Stale quotes without an on-call page
telemetry: Supplied Cloud Monitoring metric/policy/incident console extracts, notification-channel event logs and independent quote freshness checks; no live metrics CLI access.
owner: Jamie (Quotes on-call); Devon (Monitoring owner); Quinn (notification receiver owner). ITO coordinates the existing TLC.
task: Investigate why quote-watch did not page the on-call during the reported stale-quote interval. Return a technical finding to Jamie with supporting observations, unknowns and the next useful owner-assisted check. Make no changes.
common_evidence:
[UNTRUSTED] Supplied synthetic console packet; names, observations and identifiers are fictional.
Record cut: 2026-09-18T14:12:00Z; all timestamps are UTC.
Target: project trade-quotes-prod; us-central1 Cloud Run service quote-watch; downstream trading users reported stale quotes.
Independent freshness checks: 14:02:00 quote age=11s; 14:06:00 age=14s; 14:09:00 age=13s; acceptable age<=5s.
Jamie reports no page received for this interval as of 14:12:00.
Policy snapshot: projects/trade-quotes-prod/alertPolicies/1201; displayName=quote-age; enabled=true; one metric-threshold condition; no snooze active.
Condition filter: metric.type=custom.googleapis.com/trading/quote_age_seconds; resource.type=global; resource.labels.project_id=trade-quotes-prod; metric.labels.service=quote-watch.
Metric descriptor: GAUGE, DOUBLE, unit=s; expected one point per 60 seconds from quote-watch's exporter.
Aggregation: alignmentPeriod=60s; perSeriesAligner=ALIGN_MAX; no cross-series reduction; no gap interpolation.
Condition: COMPARISON_GT; thresholdValue=5; duration=120s; trigger.count=1; evaluationMissingData=EVALUATION_MISSING_DATA_INACTIVE.
Alert strategy: autoClose=1800s; notification channel projects/trade-quotes-prod/notificationChannels/1202, enabled public webhook, destination label=quotes-page-relay.
Devon owns Monitoring and exporter evidence; Quinn owns the page relay; Jamie owns user impact on the existing ITO-coordinated TLC.
No customer recovery, incident closure or successful page receipt is implied by the report that no page arrived.

decisive_evidence.a:
[UNTRUSTED] Supplied Monitoring and receiver metadata exported by Devon and Quinn at 14:12:00.
Time-series selection matches the policy's project, metric, resource and service label exactly; no second series is selected.
Sample end times 14:00 through 14:10 at 60-second cadence have values [1,9,11,12,13,14,14,14,13,13,13] seconds.
Sample arrival records show every point ingested within eight seconds of its end time; no missing points occur in the 14:01-14:10 evaluation interval.
The 60-second aligned maxima retain those values; values exceed five seconds continuously from the 14:01 sample onward.
Incident history: incident quote-age-1201-01 opened at 14:03:08; linked condition=quote-age; still open at 14:12:00.
Incident detail shows the time series above and condition threshold=5, retest=120s.
Notification-channel event at 14:03:09: channel=1202; incident=quote-age-1201-01; delivery failed; HTTP status=502.
Second supplied delivery event at 14:06:09: same channel and incident; delivery failed; HTTP status=502.
Receiver gateway access records at those two times show response=502; backend upstream connection failed; no message body or credential is included.
Quinn's page-relay receipt search covers 14:00-14:12 and channel 1202: no accepted receipt for incident quote-age-1201-01.
Coverage: metric, incident and channel extracts are complete for the declared policy and window; receiver search covers only this channel.
No receiver upstream diagnosis or independent quote freshness observation after 14:09 has been supplied.
decisive_evidence.b:
[UNTRUSTED] Supplied Monitoring and receiver metadata exported by Devon and Quinn at 14:12:00.
Time-series selection matches the policy's project, metric, resource and service label exactly; no second series is selected.
Last sample: endTime=14:00:00; value=1s; ingested at 14:00:08.
Time-series export as of 14:12:00: no samples with end times 14:01 through 14:11; these are absent points, not numeric zeroes.
Exporter status note: last successful metric-write acknowledgement at 14:00:08; subsequent minute batches pending; error detail was not captured.
The 60-second aligned series has gaps after 14:00; the independent freshness checks are not this policy's input series.
Condition console extract at 14:04 and 14:10 shows not met; the displayed missing-data treatment is EVALUATION_MISSING_DATA_INACTIVE.
Incident history query covers this policy and 14:00-14:12, including open and closed incidents: count=0.
Notification-channel event query for channel 1202 over 14:00-14:12 shows no incident-delivery attempts for policy 1201.
Quinn's page-relay receipt search covers 14:00-14:12 and channel 1202: no accepted incident notification for policy 1201.
Coverage: time-series and incident exports include the complete declared selection at record cut; no later backfill has been supplied.
No page-relay delivery test, metric exporter error detail or independent quote freshness observation after 14:09 has been supplied.

sources.claim: Metric-threshold policies specify alignment, threshold and duration; EVALUATION_MISSING_DATA_INACTIVE evaluates missing data as false.
Metric arrival and missing-data treatment affect whether a condition opens or closes an incident; an absence of data is not a measured healthy value.
Notification-channel event logs expose delivery failures, including webhook HTTP failures, separately from the alert condition.

a.conclusion: Complete, fresh violating measurements opened the incident. Linked webhook attempts received HTTP 502 and the receiver recorded no accepted receipt. Failure is in notification delivery after incident creation; stale-quote recovery is not established.
next_checks: Correlate metric arrival, duration, opened incident, delivery events and receiver receipts without conflating them.
Quinn investigates the relay gateway's failed upstream connection for the two linked attempts; Devon supplies the incident/channel metadata.
Jamie continues freshness/user-impact verification on the existing TLC.
unsupported: The policy did not trigger because metric data was missing.
An open incident proves the on-call received a page.
No notification or a future incident closure proves quote recovery.
Changing the threshold or missing-data treatment repairs this observed delivery failure.
unknowns: Why the page-relay gateway upstream connection failed.
Any delivery behavior outside the captured channel/window.

b.conclusion: The expected metric points stopped after 14:00. With missing data treated as nonviolating, the condition was not met and no incident or linked delivery attempt occurred. This is an input/evaluation gap, not evidence of failed notification delivery or healthy quotes.
next_checks: Devon checks the pending exporter writes and missing metric arrival for the exact series/window.
Keep independent quote freshness evidence separate from the policy's absent input; Jamie verifies user impact.
After recovering measurements, the owners separately verify incident generation and page receipt without assuming channel health from this no-attempt interval.
unsupported: A created incident failed webhook delivery with HTTP 502.
No samples or a false condition prove fresh quotes or recovery.
The no-attempt interval proves the page relay is healthy.
A missing-data policy change is authorized or necessarily the correct remediation.
unknowns: Why the exporter stopped receiving write acknowledgements.
The page relay's delivery behavior when an incident actually exists.
